sonnet.problem: The card says Isaac 'says he's already made Jacob his master.' The pronouns are ambiguous. 'His master' reads as Isaac's master, but Genesis 27:37 has Isaac say he made Jacob Esau's master ('I have made him your master'). The baker can't tell whose master Jacob is.
sonnet.rule: "He," "she" and "they" always point to someone the baker can tell.
